## Anima Prompt Generator: basic workflow

1. Write a short idea in **idea** (any language).
2. Start your LLM server (LM Studio, default http://127.0.0.1:1234) and pick the **model**.
3. Press Run. The generated prompt is checked against the Danbooru dictionary, then the image is made by the Anima subgraph.

**prompt_profile**: `sfw` (default), `nsfw`, or `custom` (uses the **system_prompt** field).
**artist_tag**: artist or LoRA trigger tag added to every prompt (leave empty for none).
Open the generator subgraph to see the LLM answer, the report of what was fixed, and the final prompt.

### Files used by the image part
| file | folder in ComfyUI/models |
|---|---|
| qwen_3_06b_base.safetensors | text_encoders |
| qwen_image_vae.safetensors | vae |
| anima-base-v1.0.safetensors | diffusion_models |
| anima-turbo-lora-v0.2.safetensors (turbo mode only) | loras |

Download links: ComfyUI > Templates > Anima, or the Anima page on Hugging Face (circlestone-labs/Anima).

Project page and help: https://github.com/GUntilB/Anima-Prompt-Generator

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)
